name: Lateral Thinking Gone VR: Enabling Geospatial and Topical Insights in VR
summary: The visualization is presented as a directed 3D network of channels and groups showing cross-references between entities and their weight. The network is laid out on a 3D map of the country, with the Alps in the south and the North and Baltic Seas to the north, alongside major German cities, including the capital Berlin.
